stem: What message does the poet hope to convey in the poem?

options.label: A
options.text: A person’s memories become more significant as one grows older.

options.label: B
options.text: Moving to a new place offers a person important and unique opportunities.

options.label: C
options.text: The best way to remember a person is to visit the place where that person was born.

options.label: D
options.text: A person’s sense of identity is often linked to a meaningful location in one’s past.
